message.content:
Based on the provided screenshot, here are the precise answers to your questions:

1.  **Does the navigation bar span the full width of the viewport?**
    **Yes.** The white header bar containing the logo and menu extends across the entire width of the screen.

2.  **Where is the menu located?**
    It is located **fairly close to the logo and company name on the LEFT side**. It is not pushed to the far right; there is a significant gap between the end of the menu and the button on the far right.

3.  **Between the menu items, are there small dark-blue separator bars, and are they VERTICAL or HORIZONTAL?**
    **Yes**, there are small dark-blue (or grey) separator bars between each item. They are **VERTICAL** (upright).

4.  **Are the menu items evenly spaced from each other?**
    **Yes**, the spacing between the text of the menu items appears to be uniform.

5.  **Is there any 'Request a Consultation' button in the bar?**
    **No.** There is no "Request a Consultation" button in the top header bar itself; that button is located in the main body content below the header.

6.  **What sits at the far right of the bar?**
    An **"Install app"** button (with a download icon) sits at the far right of the navigation bar.

7.  **Any visual defects: overlapping text, clipping, misalignment?**
    **No.** The elements in the header appear clean, well-aligned, and free from overlapping text or clipping issues.
